description: Objective quality eval for visual code. Properties, not pixel diffing.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader in shader.glsl implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). Uniforms iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write a main() function. Requirements: (1) a radial pulse centred in the frame, brightest at the centre and falling off toward the corners; (2) the image must be symmetric both horizontally and vertically; (3) the pulse must animate with iTime so frames at different times visibly differ; (4) the overall colour must be predominantly blue; (5) no NaN or fully black output.
